# Skrongle

> A learning app driven by JSON courses: a `course.json` manifest plus one JSON file per lesson. Every mode (Sprint, Study, Play, Guide, AI tutoring) reads the same files.

To write a course: read the course format (it is complete and self-contained), write `course.json` first, then one lesson file at a time, and reply with JSON only. Check files against the JSON Schema. In the app, add them on the course page (`/courses/<id>`); every save validates the whole course and the error names the file and field.

## Course authoring

- [Course format]({base}/docs/course-format.md): every field and rule of `course.json` and lesson files, with a minimal valid course. The app's own course generator uses this exact text.
- [Course JSON Schema]({base}/docs/course.schema.json): the same rules as JSON Schema (manifest<!-- no-themes --> and<!-- /no-themes --><!-- themes -->,<!-- /themes --> lesson<!-- themes -->, theme<!-- /themes --> definitions).
- [How a course is built]({base}/docs/course-structure.md): a worked example from the Spanish course and which field switches on which feature.
